description.narrative: Ghana Power Compact - Financial and Operational Turnaround ECG1 - Commercial Loss Reduction Activity: Specific interventions to address commercial losses include: (A) Creation of service connection standards and normalization of existing services to update existing standards with a new design; train ECG personnel to enforce the new standards; and repair and upgrade non-conforming services. (B) Strengthening the loss control program by providing the loss control units at ECG with the means (training, tools, and equipment) to more effectively reduce commercial losses. (C) Installation of automated meter reading meters at special load tariff service locations and on selected non-special load tariff service locations in the ECG Target Regions as well as installation of metering at critical nodes of the distribution system in the ECG Target Regions to provide ECG the ability to identify and monitor where technical and commercial losses are occurring. (D) Replacement of legacy credit meters with pre-payment meters in the ECG Target Regions to improve collection efficiency and timely closing of monthly financial statements.
